artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for argv overflow fix across three shell scripts

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed E2BIG argv overflow in roadmap-integration.sh by replacing content-passing with temp-file path-passing at two sites; applied the same mktemp pattern to issue-grouping.sh (2 sites) and tier-selection.sh (2 sites) for consistency. Verified against the real 94 KB state.json with no error and valid JSON output.

memory_candidates.content: Shell scripts that invoke inline Python heredocs via `python3 - "$VAR" << 'PYEOF'` will abort with E2BIG (Argument list too long) when the variable content exceeds the OS ARG_MAX limit (~2 MB on Linux). The fix: write the content to a mktemp file with `printf '%s' "$VAR" > "$TMP"`, pass the path as argv, read in Python with `json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))`, and `rm -f` after. `printf '%s'` avoids spurious trailing-newline corruption. Short strings (index lists, flags) can stay as argv.
